div.l: Of a solempne and a grete frat̉er nite
Full fressh and newe her gere pyked was
Her knyves were nought chaped with bras
But all wᵗith silủer wrought full clene and wele
Her gurdels and her pouches eủerydele
Wele semed ech of hem a feire burgeys
To sit in þe yeldehalle vp on þe hie deys
Eủerych for the wysdome that he kan
Was shaply to be an Aldreman
For catell hade they ynough and rent
And eke her wyues wold yt wele assent
And elles certein þei were to blame
Yt is full faire to be clept ma dame
And go to vigiles all byfore
And haue a mantell rially bore
A coke they hade wᵗith hem for the nones
To boyle the chekyns wᵗith the marybones
And poudre marchant tart and galyngale
Wele koude he know a draght of londou ale
He coude rost seeth boyll and frye
Make mortrewes and wele bake a pye
But grete harme was yt as thought me
That on his shene a mormaile . hade he
And blanchemanger made he wᵗith þe best
A shipman þere was þat woned fer by west
For oght þat I wote he was of Dertemouth
He rode on a rouncy as wele as he couth
In a gowne of faldyng vn to the kne
A dagger hangyng on a lace hade . he
Aboute his nek vndre his arme adoun
The hote som̉er hade made his hew all broun
And certeinly he was a gode felawe
Full many a draught of wyne hade he drawe
Fro Burdeux warde while þe Chapman slepe
Of nyce conscience toke he no kepe
Yf þat he faught and hade þe hier honde
By wat̉er he sent yt home fro eủery londe
But to reken wele of his craft the tydes
Þe stremes and the strandes hīm besyd ys
His herberowe his mone and his lodes manage
